paired_design: A same request/circuit/proof through common verifier with randomized Derived/Table order; B independent complete pipeline intervals for both output modes on same immutable batch, paired/randomized order
seed_role: order_seed is execution ordering only; same original/variant fixture corpus reused across all five process repeats; exact fixture base and generator initial seed in per-cell metadata
A_compile: compile_with_hints: canonical compile plus its existing layout hints; direct timer includes both
A_encode_preparation: separate public prepare held for facade encoding/encoded verifier; prepare cost recorded separately and excluded from direct stage timers
B_complete_interval: actual parallel witness generation through encoded verification; result assembly, tick probes and temporary drops included, returned encoded drops and full-envelope hash comparisons outside
cpu: phase process ticks from /proc/self/stat (quantized); whole process GNU time user/system seconds and peakRSS sidecar; no tick-to-nanosecond precision claim
rss: per-process GNU peak includes fixtures, prepared state, metadata, measurement row buffers, pools/results and both paired output modes; no per-output-mode peak attribution
C_root_chain: same key/sibling path, explicit constructor and timed cursor root equality; warmups excluded from timed chain cursor; no persistent/distributed commit claim
units: inner proof/request pipeline costs, not completed bidirectional synchronization SPS
